task_plans.coverage_statement: The executive orders, OPM memoranda, Attorney General implementation memorandum, OFCCP disposition page, and Foreign Service directive expose a bounded cross-government programme and office implementation surface, including termination, RIF, retention, transfer, reorganization, and administrative-closure instructions. They do not expose the complete agency-by-agency programme, office, budget, position, disposition, appeal, correction, and no-action inventory.
included_rows: named executive-wide inventory and termination requirements
OPM initial, RIF, and further implementation instructions
Foreign Service criterion change
OFCCP cease-and-desist, abeyance, resumed statutory programmes, and administrative closure rows
unavailable_rows: complete agency inventory submissions to OMB and OPM
complete programme, office, position, budget, retained-function, renamed, consolidated, appealed, corrected, and no-action rows
versioned agency implementation instructions and final dispositions
refused_rows: executive-wide instructions are not treated as completed agency inventories
named agency examples are not treated as the complete federal denominator
administrative closure is not treated as proof of programme merit, motive, prevalence, or complete consequence
task_plans.negative_search_statement: The bounded official source set exposes mandatory inventory and implementation requirements but not the complete submitted inventories or final agency dispositions.
correction_route: agency records and implementation offices
OMB and OPM inventory custody
FOIA, inspector-general, congressional, administrative, and judicial review

named litigants are not treated as prevalence, motive, racial-order, or system-wide burden findings

correction_route: agency personnel, programme, grant, and enforcement records

administrative, judicial, legislative, union, and inspector-general review
